tc.scopeSupplier: Scope of Supplier (MEGAHOODS / Megaverks Technologies): Supply, transportation, installation, testing and commissioning of all equipment listed in the scope of supply above.
tc.scopeClient: Scope of Client: All civil work, electrical power supply cabling, wall openings, scaffolding / support structure, and electrical termination at the equipment location.
scopeNotes: GI ducting quantities are approximate, based on the drawing. Final measurement will be taken after the site visit and installation.
This quotation covers equipment and installation only. Any additional item not listed above will be quoted separately on request.
exclusions: Electrical cabling from mains to equipment location (Client scope)
Civil work including wall openings, concrete pads and structural modifications (Client scope)
Scaffolding / working platform arrangement / blower placement platform or any other blower placement platform (Client scope)
Fire suppression system installation (unless specifically quoted in the hood section)
Any additional work outside the items listed in the scope of supply
Government permissions, licenses or approvals required for installation
Insurance of goods in transit or at site (can be arranged at extra cost on request)

terms.label: Payment Terms
terms.text: 70% advance along with the Purchase Order. Balance 30% immediately after completion of installation and commissioning.

terms.label: GST
terms.text: {GST}% extra (CGST {GST_HALF}% + SGST {GST_HALF}%) as calculated above. Client GST number must be provided for tax invoice generation.

terms.label: Delivery Timeline
terms.text: 2 to 3 weeks from the date of Purchase Order and receipt of advance payment. Site work commences 10 days after receipt of advance.

terms.label: Quotation Validity
terms.text: This quotation is valid for {VALIDITY} days from the date of issue. Prices may be revised after the validity period.

terms.label: Warranty
terms.text: {WARRANTY} months from the date of commissioning against manufacturing defects only. Does not cover damage due to misuse, negligence or force majeure.

terms.label: Raw Material Price Fluctuation
terms.text: Prices are based on current SS / GI material rates. Significant fluctuation (>10%) may warrant a price revision with prior notice.

terms.label: Force Majeure
terms.text: We shall not be liable for delays due to circumstances beyond our control, including natural disasters, strikes or government actions.

terms.label: Acceptance
terms.text: Acceptance of this quotation by signature and stamp constitutes a binding agreement subject to the above terms.

terms.label: Cancellation
terms.text: Orders once confirmed cannot be cancelled. In case of cancellation after the PO, the advance amount will be forfeited.

terms.label: Jurisdiction
terms.text: Any dispute arising shall be subject to Bengaluru jurisdiction courts only.
